body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Haier Korea demonstrated artificial intelligence air conditioner ''KFRd-72LW/O'' which can be controlled by cell phone and PDA from a distance. There are two models: a standard type ''KFRd-72LW/O'' vs a wall mounted type ''KFRd-35GW/O'' both equipped with high-tech LED display, air purifier, anion generator and dehumidifier.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
